files.ops/exporter-notes.md:
# Exporter notes

The plc-exporter ships cycle logs to logs/ every minute. During upgrades and maintenance windows the exporter pauses, and the lines in between are not backfilled; the raw log stays on the PLC for 14 days and can be pulled over the service port.

logs/ holds per-machine, per-day logs.
